svg.text: Workflow 3 — Complete Flow Summary (Default → Action → Popup for Every Page)
S1: Officer Login (Empty) → S2: Login (Filled + Success Alert) → S3: Analytics Dashboard (Overview — Category Distribution + Top Hotspots)
S4: Trends Tab (MoM Change) → S5: Hotspots Tab (Detailed with Solve Rate) → S6: Patterns Tab (Day of Week Analysis) → S7: Performance Tab (Officer Rankings)
S8: Predictions — Risk Assessment (Empty) → S9: Risk Results (HIGH 8.2/10 + Recommendation + SweetAlert) → S10: Pattern Matching (Empty) → S11: Pattern Results (4 Matches + SweetAlert)
S12: Forecast Trends (Empty) → S13: Forecast Results (6-Month Projection with YoY Change, Trend Badges, Severity Ranks + SweetAlert)
Project: Crime Management Analysis System (CMAS) | Entities: Crime, Location, Officer, Crime_Type | Views: Crime_Trends_Monthly, Crime_Hotspots, Crime_Patterns_Weekly | Auth: JWT + bcrypt
